final: {"number": 800, "label": "question", "route": "answer-draft", "related": [271, 1262], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java"], "reply": "Hi, Mockito can stub a protected method, but the test code has to be able to see it. Protected members are visible inside the same package, so put your test class in the same package as Struts2Action (for example, the same package path under src/test/java). Then create a partial mock with Mockito.spy(new InvoiceAction()) and stub the method with Mockito.doReturn(mockSession).when(spy).getSession(). Use doReturn rather than when(...), because when(spy.getSession()) would call the real method first. The spy section of the Javadoc for Mockito.spy in mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java explains this. Hope that helps."}
